gripper_span.provenance:
measured 2026-08-12. VALUE stands on ONE leg only; the second leg has been RETRACTED the same day.

(1) STANDS -- LAB "T. 抓不住": trimodal terminal jaw separation over 122 latched episodes, no mass
between the modes: closed-on-air 0.000-0.017 | real grasp 0.0498-0.0571 (66/68 within +-0.0002, on a
5 cm object) | STUCK AT THE OPEN LIMIT 0.0802-0.0804. The open-limit band IS the full-open span.
That entry also states the terminal opening is itself the instrument for "how wide a section was
actually held".

(2) RETRACTED 2026-08-12 -- I had written: "this box's same reading has a hard ceiling at 0.800 over
1893 samples while the COMMAND is 1.0, therefore reading x 0.1 = metres." The mapping is NOT
supported. Calibrating it against 59 REAL grasps (object as the ruler: section width / reading) gives
a factor whose median is 0.0825 but whose range is 0.0011 .. 0.7516 -- nearly 700x. A factor that
scatters that far is not a unit conversion; it means the section width 2a reports and the gap the
jaws actually span are DIFFERENT QUANTITIES. Worst single row: a solid block reported as a 0.0048 m
section while the jaws stopped at reading 0.30. Root cause under investigation: the finger-wide strip
can cut TANGENTIALLY along a face and read a thin skin -- a limitation I had wrongly documented as
affecting only zero-thickness open shells.

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR CONSUMERS: use 0.0803 m as the full-open span. Do NOT use it to convert a raw
gripper reading into metres -- that conversion has no measured support on this body today.

WHAT THIS REPLACES: a hand-filled 0.088 with no traceable provenance
(robot_description(x5 joint7+joint8)=DECLARED_DEBT), 8 mm / 10% too large.

STILL OPEN: the camera route stays REFUSED and correctly so -- LAB "夹爪张开" 2026-08-11, five GPU
runs; the jaws are black, at the frame edge, against a dark background, so the detector reads
"entering/leaving frame", not "opening/closing".

superseded.provenance:
measured, two independent legs agreeing, 2026-08-12.
(1) LAB "T. 抓不住" trimodal terminal jaw separation over 122 latched episodes, no mass between the modes: closed-on-air 0.000-0.017 | real grasp 0.0498-0.0571 (66/68 within +-0.0002, on a 5 cm object) | STUCK AT THE OPEN LIMIT 0.0802-0.0804. The open-limit band IS the span. That LAB entry also states the terminal opening is itself the instrument for "how wide a section was actually held".
(2) this box, 1893 samples of the same reading across grasp/s2d rollouts: hard ceiling at 0.800, never exceeded, with a mode there (47 samples), while the COMMAND is 1.0 -> the reading saturates at the open limit.
INFERENCE, stated as such: (2) is a normalised/x10 reading, not metres -- the driver's own measured reach band is [0.13425, 0.6019] m, so a jaw opening 0.8 m would exceed the whole arm's reach. Mapping reading -> metres is x0.1, from the ceiling correspondence 0.800 <-> 0.0802-0.0804.
WHAT THIS REPLACES: a hand-filled 0.088 with no traceable provenance, carried in contact_gen.jaw_span as robot_description(x5 joint7+joint8)=DECLARED_DEBT. It is 8 mm (10%) too large; the shovel episodes (candidate sections 7.3/8.4/8.5 cm, three closes on air) are consistent with the smaller true span.
STILL OPEN: the camera route (measuring jaw-tip pixel separation) remains REFUSED and correctly so -- LAB "夹爪张开" 2026-08-11, five GPU runs, the jaws are black, at the frame edge, against a dark background, so the detector reads "entering/leaving frame", not "opening/closing".

home_pose.provenance:
home_pose:两臂复位时的末端位姿(位置 m + 四元数 wxyz),由驱动 homecal 从 /root/homerec.txt 算出。
记录来源:RoboDojo 四个任务(general_pickup / stack_blocks / classify_objects / organize_table)
各若干集,在**每集下达任何指令之前**读一次 s20 的末端位姿 —— 纯读,不给机器人发指令。
每臂 n=11,位置散布 0.000 mm、四元数散布 0.00000 ⇒ 复位是确定性的,逐位相同。
用途:官方 all_robot_back_to_origin 拿的正是复位那一刻的末端位姿当尺子(容差 ±0.15 m / 20 deg)。
存的是 14 个数:先左臂 xyz+wxyz,再右臂 xyz+wxyz。

reach.provenance:
measured 2026-08-13 from 165 wrist-down descent attempts already on disk (floormap cells, both arms, both grid halves): radius from this arm own base vs whether the commanded pose was attained (arrival error < 0.020 m). Band, walls and separation test all come from probe::reach; no coefficient here was typed in.
🔴 It REPLACES a band measured WITHOUT the wrist constraint ([0.13425, 0.6019]). That band was correct for its own question and wrong for the way the stack uses it: every planner here forces the wrist down, and under that constraint the outer wall is 0.419 m, not 0.602 m. The 18 cm between them is where a whole night of "the command went out and the hand did not move one step" lived - the controller was refusing the pose, and nothing said so.
reach.unit: metres from this arm own base, measured with the wrist held pointing down

Stored value 0.1451 left unchanged (0.0020 from the median, well inside 1sigma) so that any behaviour change after the gate merge is attributable to the gate.
